title: Unity of the Spirit
definition: The unity of the Spirit is the bond of peace and shared life that the Holy Spirit creates among believers in Christ.
summary: The Spirit unites believers across backgrounds, weaknesses, and differences into one body under Christ.
christFocus: The Spirit joins believers to Christ and to one another, making unity a Gospel witness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit unites believers across backgrounds, weaknesses, and differences into one body under Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
